newsitem.title: USA: Ryder to slash 2,100 jobs, sell nearly 200 facilities.
newsitem.headline: Ryder to slash 2,100 jobs, sell nearly 200 facilities.

text.p: Ryder System, Inc. said Monday it will slash about 2,100 jobs and dispose of nearly 200 facilities in an ongoing restructuring to cut costs and improve profits.
Ryder also said it will take a pretax charge of $215 million in the l996 fourth quarter for the actions, resulting in a net loss for the period and full-year 1996.
Steps taken so far in the restructuring are expected to produce pretax savings of about $75 million in l997 and more than $150 million a year after that, it said.
About 700 employees have already taken advantage of a voluntary early retirement programme that was offered late last year as part of the restructuring, it said.

"Important as these savings are, the real heart of the programme is the structural change we have made in our leading lines of business," said Ryder, citing Chairman, President and Chief Executive M. Anthony Burns in a meeting here with security analysts.
"We have put our integrated logistics and truck leasing and rental businesses in a position to succeed, and we will accept no less."
Most of the restructuring has already been completed and remaining actions will be completed during 1997, Ryder said.
